topic: POV cost of waiting: small rugs refused at inbound; myth: rugs have no flammability rule; fact: 16 CFR part 1631 covers small carpets and rugs and the GCC must cite it
vo: Myth: small rugs have no flammability rule.
My pallets reach the fulfillment center. Refused. The compliance file is incomplete.
The catch? Part sixteen thirty-one covers small carpets and rugs. My G C C never listed it.
Every day they sit, I lose Q four sales. So I fix the file first.
Blocked right now? Forward the notice. Get your gap list in twenty-four hours.
caption:
Pallets refused at the dock, and every day they sit is a day of Q4 you don't get back.
16 CFR part 1631 is the surface flammability standard for small carpets and rugs, whatever fiber they're made of.
A general certificate of conformity has to cite each rule the product is certified to, so a rug GCC that skips part 1631 is a gap.
Say a seller's file is missing that line. That's the first thing to fix.

sources.claim: Part 1631 applies to all types of small carpets and rugs regardless of fiber
sources.quote: This Standard provides a test method to determine the surface flammability of small carpets and rugs when exposed to a standard small source of ignition under carefully prescribed draft-protected conditions. It is applicable to all types of small carpets and rugs used as floor covering materials regardless of their method of fabrication or whether they are made of natural or synthetic fibers or films, or combinations of, or substitutes for these.

sources.claim: Finished products subject to a rule enforced by CPSC must be accompanied by a certificate
sources.quote: Finished products subject to a consumer product safety rule under the CPSA, or similar rule, ban, standard, or regulation under any other law enforced by the Commission, which are imported for consumption or warehousing, or are distributed in commerce, must be accompanied by a finished product certificate.

sources.claim: The certificate cites each rule the product is certified to
sources.quote: Finished product certificates must identify separately all applicable rules, bans, standards, or regulations.

sources.claim: GCC is the certificate for general-use (non-children's) products
sources.quote: Children's Product Certificate (CPC) means a certificate of compliance for a finished product issued pursuant to section 14(a)(2) of the CPSA, 15 U.S.C. 2063, and part 1107 of this chapter. ... General Certificate of Conformity (GCC) means a certificate of compliance for a finished product issued pursuant to section 14(a)(1) of the CPSA, 15 U.S.C. 2063(a)(1).
